title: Schools, Universities, and Theatre in the Mother Tongue
grammar: Concessive independence: függetlenül attól, hogy... ('regardless of whether / that...')
goal: I can describe Hungarian higher education, theatres, and cultural institutions across neighboring countries.
I can use függetlenül attól, hogy... to state policy principles, educational rights, and institutional realities.
I can discuss Babeș–Bolyai University, Selye János University, and Ferenc Rákóczi II College.
